After 9 quarters, VIP IN reported double-digit top-line growth of 15.2% YoY to INR4,681mn (PLe INR4,389mn).

Post COVID, this is the first instance wherein VIP IN’s top-line growth has surpassed SII IN with GM performance of both players being broadly in sync (VIP IN/SII IN reported GM of 44.4%/44.3% respectively) indicating gain in market share was not discounting led.

VIP IN is aiming for a double-digit top- line growth in 2HFY27E, and we expect GM performance to sustain led by portfolio rejig (50+ new ranges launched in 1HFY27), price hike and shift towards premiumization.
